title: 第21章 新名新身——陈凡
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
乱石镇的地下密室中，药香渐渐淡去。

    林渊睁开眼，自口中吐出一缕半尺长的灰色浊气，浊气击在石壁上，发出嗤嗤的轻响。

    三颗固元丹已经彻底炼化。

    他体内的液化灵力比七日前粗壮了约莫一成，气海中的灵力漩涡运转自如，再无任何虚浮之感。

    筑基初期的境界，在这一刻彻底稳固。

    他没有在乱石镇多做停留。

    这地方刚死了三名血煞门的劫修，血煞门的邪修随时可能寻来。

    任何一丝侥幸都可能招致杀身之祸。

    林渊戴上斗笠，推开密室铁门，悄无声息地离开了客栈。

    他没有直接前往柳溪镇，而是收敛气息，折返返回了迷雾大泽的地下黑市。

    按老祖的经验，越是危险、刚发生过变故的地方，在风波过后的短时间内反而最安全。

    血煞门的人绝对想不到，杀了他们门徒的人，会大摇大摆地重新回到黑市。

    更重要的是，他需要通过情报墙，确认陈、刘两家如今的动向，同时彻底斩断自己与林渊这个身份的最后一丝联系。

    半日后，林渊再次通过那条狭窄的石缝通道，走进了铁匠铺。

    铺子里的地心火依旧在轰鸣，独臂的铁手正坐在一条小木凳上，单手用磨刀石打磨着一把看起来平平无奇的柴刀。

    听到脚步声，铁手抬起头，看到戴着青铜面具的林渊，眼中闪过一丝诧异，随后笑道：“你小子没事吧。这几天黑市外头闹得挺凶，血煞门死了三个精锐，正在到处咬人。”

    林渊走到铁案前，语气平静：“三个炼气期的劫修而已，死就死了。”

    铁手打磨柴刀的手微微一顿，深深地看了林渊一眼。

    他能感觉得到，七天不见，眼前这个戴面具的年轻人，身上的锋锐之气非但没有减弱，反而变得更加内敛。

    这是剑道境界大进的迹象。

    “飞剑用着可还顺手？”铁手问。

    “很好，破甲极强。”林渊说。

    铁手扔下磨刀石，拍了拍手上的铁屑，站起身道：“那当然，那是上古剑胚的底子。不过你那把剑现在只是一阶极品，凡铁的材质限制了它的威力。你若想让它真正成长，日后少不得要寻些上好的二阶金属性矿石喂养。若是能寻到太乙精金之类的材料，这把剑自己就能破开等阶。”

    说到这里，铁手自嘲地笑了一声：“当然，那种神物，整个云国都不一定有一两。老子多嘴了。”

    林渊将这些话默默记在心里，这便是金螭剑日后的成长路线。

    他从袖中取出一枚普通的传讯玉简，放在铁案上。

    “这是何意？”铁手皱眉。

    “我缺一个相熟的炼器师。日后若有高阶矿石，或者需要提升这把剑的品阶，我会再来寻你。这玉简里是一个联络地址。”林渊说道。

    他留下的是柳溪镇周氏铁匠铺的地址。

    周铁匠是黑市的眼线，本身就在黑市的情报网里。

    林渊通过周铁匠来联系铁手，既能隐藏自己真正的隐居之所，又能保持一条高阶炼器师的人脉。
content_en:
In the underground secret room of Luanshi Town, the scent of medicine gradually faded away.

    Lin Yuan opened his eyes and blew out a half-foot-long gray turbid air from his mouth. The turbid air hit the stone wall and made a soft hissing sound.

    The three Solid Yuan Pills have been completely refined.

    The liquefied spiritual power in his body was about 10% stronger than it was seven days ago, and the spiritual power vortex in the sea of ​​​​qi moved freely, without any sense of emptiness.

    The realm at the initial stage of foundation building was completely stable at this moment.

    He did not stay longer in Rock Town.

    Three robbery cultivators from the Blood Demon Sect have just died here, and the evil cultivators from the Blood Demon Sect may come at any time.

    Any luck could lead to death.

    Lin Yuan put on his bamboo hat, pushed open the iron door of the secret room, and left the inn quietly.

    He did not go directly to Liuxi Town, but gathered his breath and turned back to the underground black market in the foggy swamp.

    According to the experience of our ancestors, the more dangerous the place, the place that has just experienced an accident is the safest in the short period of time after the storm has passed.

    The people of the Blood Demon Sect would never have imagined that the person who killed their disciple would return to the black market with such arrogance.

    More importantly, he needed to pass the intelligence wall to confirm the current movements of the Chen and Liu families, and at the same time completely cut off the last link between himself and Lin Yuan's identity.

    Half a day later, Lin Yuan walked through the narrow stone passage again and walked into the blacksmith shop.

    The inner earth fire in the shop was still roaring, and the one-armed iron hand was sitting on a small wooden bench, polishing an ordinary-looking hatchet with one hand using a whetstone.

    Hearing the sound of footsteps, Tie Shou raised his head and saw Lin Yuan wearing a bronze mask. A trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then he smiled and said, "Are you okay, kid? There has been a lot of commotion outside the black market these days. Three elite members of the Blood Demon Sect have died and are biting people everywhere."

    Lin Yuan walked to the iron case and said in a calm tone: "It's just a three-year Qi refining period. If you die, you will die."

    Tie Shou's hand that was polishing the hatchet paused slightly, and he took a deep look at Lin Yuan.

    He could feel that after seven days of absence, the sharp aura of the masked young man in front of him had not weakened, but had become more restrained.

    This is a sign of great progress in the realm of swordsmanship.

    "Is the flying sword easy to use?" Tie Shou asked.

    "Very good, it's extremely powerful at breaking armor." Lin Yuan said.

    Iron Hand threw down the whetstone, patted the iron filings on his hand, stood up and said: "Of course, that is the basis of the ancient sword embryo. However, your sword is only the first level of the best, and the material of ordinary iron limits its power. If you want it to truly grow, you will have to find some good second level metallic ores to feed it in the future. If you can find materials such as Taiyi fine gold, this sword can break through the first level on its own."

    Having said this, Tie Shou laughed to himself: "Of course, there may not be even one or two of those divine objects in the entire Yun Kingdom. I'm talking too much."

    Lin Yuan silently remembered these words in his heart. This was the future growth path of Jin Chijian.

    He took out an ordinary summons jade slip from his sleeve and placed it on the iron case.

    "What does this mean?" Tie Shou frowned.

    "I need a familiar weapon refiner. If there are high-grade ores in the future, or if I need to upgrade the grade of this sword, I will come to you again. This jade slip contains a contact address." Lin Yuan said.

    What he left behind was the address of Zhou's blacksmith shop in Liuxi Town.

    Zhou Tiejiang is the black market's spy and he is in the black market's intelligence network.

    Lin Yuan contacted Tie Shou through Blacksmith Zhou, so that he could hide his true retreat and maintain a network of high-level weapon refiners.
